main_claim: I don't know this specific paper. I know the general topic: under hydrostatic pressure, UTe2 shows multiple superconducting phases. Earlier work, such as Braithwaite et al. (2019), Thomas et al. (2020) and Aoki et al., reported a second superconducting transition, a Tc that rises to roughly 3 K near 1 GPa, and a magnetic phase above about 1.5 GPa. That points to a possible change in order-parameter symmetry between phases. I can't attribute specific claims to this paper.
